The Unofficial Election Results Mapping Dashboard and PDF Summary has been updated to include the Questioned and Absentee Ballots counted on October 13, 2026.

The Unofficial Results PDF by Precinct to include Questioned and Absentee Ballots counted will be available by end of business on Wednesday, October 14, 2026.

Municipal elections are conducted each year on the first Tuesday in October. The Borough Clerk administers municipal elections for the Borough Mayor, Assembly, School Board and Interior Alaska Natural Gas Utility (IGU). The Assembly, School Board and IGU seats are at large, representing all citizens of the borough. Municipal Elections, by state statute, are non-partisan elections, free from party affiliation.

Municipal Elections include elections for the City of Fairbanks and City of North Pole. While these elections are administered by the Borough Clerk, information specific to the cities can be found on their respective websites.

Accessible Voting Information 

Accessible Voting Machines are available at the Early Vote Station and Absentee In Person Voting Stations at the Cities of Fairbanks and North Pole. These machines are not available at polling locations on Election day. To learn more, contact the Borough Clerk's Office by email at clerks@fnsb.gov or phone at (907) 459-1401.
